name: Xsum_MIA_benchmark_RH
description: A benchmark built around the XSum summarization dataset to evaluate membership inference attacks (privacy leakage) against summarization models. It provides test cases and attack labels to measure how easily a model reveals whether a particular example was used during training. The benchmark is intended for privacy/security research assessing model vulnerability to membership inference in text-generation/summarization settings.
evaluation_method: Attack metrics such as AUC (ROC), attack accuracy, precision and recall
reputation: A niche dataset for privacy researchers studying membership inference on summarization models; modest adoption within the privacy community.
